summary: Iteration 28 (Control Center) verified end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passing covering (a) authorization isolation — all 8 /admin/control/* endpoints return 403 for normal customer token and 200 for SUPER_ADMIN; (b) Overview KPIs render real counts and money metrics (mrr/arr/revenue_month/churn/trial_to_paid) are None while money_available=false; (c) date range filter works; (d) Health, Referrals, Security, Audit search; (e) Flags create+toggle round-trip; (f) Entitlements get+set persist; (g) Pricing preview + publish creates a new commercial_config_versions entry AND audit log entry action=admin.pricing.publish; (h) Customer detail + resend_verification + suspend/unsuspend flow for teamtest@demo.com. Frontend: Login as admin@ariadni.id redirects to /control; Control Center shell renders; all 14 nav sections load their ctrl-{section} root; kpi-mrr/arr/rev/churn show 'Not available until billing connected'; ctrl-overview-range present; customers-search filters + row click opens customer-detail dialog; plans-preview-btn opens plans-publish-dialog with apply-new / apply-migrate / plans-confirm-publish; flag-key-input + flag-add + flag-toggle-{key} work; SUPER_ADMIN admin row has NO cust-suspend button (also no cust-resend / cust-revoke — see note); industry-toggle-* renders (12); ent-plan-pro + ent-save present. Normal customer (work@gmail.com) is redirected to /dashboard from /control, /control/customers, /control/plans, and /admin/commercial.

issues: DialogContent is missing `aria-describedby` / `Description` (Radix a11y warning in console). Not blocking but should be addressed for a11y.

When the target user is SUPER_ADMIN, cust-suspend is correctly hidden — but cust-resend and cust-revoke are ALSO hidden in that case. Requirement was only 'no suspend button on a SUPER_ADMIN row'. Verify with product whether resend/revoke should still be available on admin rows (they still are safe operations).

(product decision) Confirm whether cust-resend / cust-revoke should be available on SUPER_ADMIN customer rows — they are currently hidden along with cust-suspend.

Overview money metrics correctly return None with money_available=false so the UI can render the 'Not available until billing connected' state — good separation of concerns.
Pricing publish is versioned (commercial_config_versions) AND audited (action=admin.pricing.publish) atomically — good.
SuperAdminRoute (App.js) short-circuits to /dashboard for non-SUPER_ADMIN — verified with work@gmail.com. Old /admin/platform + /admin/commercial redirects behave correctly.
ControlCenter.jsx is 615 lines and holds 15 subsections + shell inline. Consider splitting per-section components into /pages/control/*.jsx files for maintainability if further sections are added.
